unknown_clause.description: An on_unknown clause of a selection document that the scheduling layer does not apply.

drop_candidate.description: The clause drops the candidate from ranking.

substitute.description: The clause substitutes a declared verdict (gate) or value (term).

reader_problem.description: Why no reader can refresh an instance fact, or what is wrong with a reader binding.

key_not_marked.description: The recognition maintenance package carries no reading mark for the key.

designated_operation.description: The package declares a designated operation, so it is not a reader.

no_marks.description: The package carries no reading mark.

recognize_only.description: The package is recognize-only, so it is not a reader.

stability_termination.description: The package ends on a stability termination, so it is not a reader.

policy_fact_authority.description: The key is a policy fact of the catalog, so a reading of it is refused.

live_pool_key.description: The key is observed by a ledger-fact pool, so a reading of it was refused. No longer given since Workflow #390 POOL-1: such a reading is the pool's base.

package_unbound.description: The instance has no recognition maintenance package bound.

not_declared.description: The bound package is not declared for recognition maintenance, so the binding is ignored.

disabled.description: Fact refresh is turned off in the configuration.

confidence_below_document.description: The reading mark's confidence floor is below the floor the document declares.

interval_exceeds_freshness.description: The minimum reading interval exceeds the freshness the document or the mark requires.

package_unreadable.description: The bound package cannot be read or admitted (Workflow #384 D2-S2).

reading_problem.description: Why a reading mark gave no reading on a frame handed to recognition (Workflow #384 D2-S2).

invalid_integer.description: The text is not an integer of the declared format.

overflow.description: The integer does not fit 64 bits.

out_of_range.description: The integer is outside the declared range.

region_unresolved.description: The OCR target's region could not be placed on the frame.

provider_failed.description: The OCR provider failed, or the recognition ended without an answer.

low_confidence.description: The confidence is below the mark's floor.

join_timeout.description: The recognition had not returned when the run's join timeout ended.

scan_alignment_failure.description: Why a scan session found no single shift for a frame (Workflow #308 SEL-L3).

too_few_matches.description: No cluster of pairs reaches min_overlap_instances.

no_consistent_shift.description: No cluster of pairs is consistent, for any other reason.

ambiguous_shift.description: Two or more consistent clusters lie inside the motion's window.

unexpected_displacement.description: No consistent cluster lies inside the motion's window, but one lies outside it.

scan_spacing_failure.description: Which spacing check of a scan session found a missed anchor (Workflow #308 SEL-L3).

axis_gap.description: Two consecutive rows lie further apart than max_axis_gap_px.

row_short.description: A row holds another number of positions than spacing.columns.

leading_gap.description: The first row starts further from the band's leading edge than max_axis_gap_px.

trailing_gap.description: The last row starts further from the band's trailing edge than max_trailing_gap_px.

cross_gap.description: A row's first position, or the next one, lies further across the axis than max_cross_lead_px or max_cross_gap_px.

scan_bound.description: Which bound of a scan session ran out (Workflow #308 SEL-L3).

reposition_viewports.description: max_reposition_viewports: the rewind and return viewports.

duration.description: max_ms, or the task's own deadline when it comes first.

selection_kind.description: The kind of a selection policy's decision (Workflow #308).

empty.description: No candidate survived and the mode accepts an empty answer.

insufficient.description: Fewer candidates survived than the policy requires.

ambiguous.description: Candidates tied at the cut after every tie-break key.

unknown.description: The evaluation aborted on an unusable input.

selection_blocking.description: Why unknown instances keep a selection decision from standing (Workflow #308 SEL-L4b).

unknown_instances.description: An empty or insufficient decision with at least one unknown instance.

outranked_possible.description: A selected decision that an unknown instance might outrank.

identity_state.description: How a confirmed or expected business identity differed from the chosen one (Workflow #308 SEL-L4b).

absent.description: No actionable instance at the chosen position or, for a template expect_identity, no pool entry passed.

unknown.description: Only Unknown readings until the timeout.

no_choice.description: The choice_of step chose nothing in this run.

adjustment_reason.description: Why a run's confirmed resource adjustment wrote nothing (Workflow #384 D2-S3).

base_missing.description: The key had no current record to adjust.

base_expired.description: The key's current record had expired.

newer_observation.description: An observation of the key at or after the confirmation already holds the change.

amount_unresolved.description: The change the screen shows could not be read; the key's record is dropped.

after_read_missing.description: No reading of the key followed the confirmation; the key's record is dropped.

refresh_limit.description: Which limit holds an instance's recognition maintenance package back (Workflow #384 D2-S4).

daily_limit.description: The package's dispatches today reached scheduling.fact_refresh.daily_limit.

failure_pause.description: Its failed runs in a row reached scheduling.fact_refresh.max_consecutive_failures today.

schedulable_state.description: The instance's schedulable-pack state does not include the package now.

activity_window.description: The instance's activity window is closed or its activity budget spent.

placement.description: The instance cannot place the package.

entry_problem.description: Why a contained task's entry page set is refused at admission (Workflow #373 NAV-3b).

empty.description: The entry page set names no page.

too_many.description: The entry page set names more than 16 pages.

duplicate.description: The entry page set names one page twice.

any_in_set.description: The entry page set names any, which only a single entry page may be.

unresolved.description: A page of the entry page set is blank or is not exactly one page of the package's page set.

phase_start_missing.description: No stage of the phased route lists an operation from a page of the entry page set.

phase_start_ambiguous.description: More than one stage of the phased route lists an operation from a page of the entry page set.

event_type.description: A ledger event type; each has the category a record without an outcome takes.

receipt_state.description: The state of an IPC receipt.

claim_kind.description: Who holds an instance or waits for it, in the one queue per instance (Workflow #369).

startup_package.description: An instance's startup package after an emulator start.

autostart.description: A configured emulator start at daemon start.

direct_task_run.description: A direct task run from the CLI, the console or MCP.

input_lifecycle.description: A safe reset or an application lifecycle command.

resume_reconnect.description: The reconnect of an instance resume.

daemon_start_preparation.description: The dedicated preparation lease of a connection preparation.

resource_close.description: A dedicated retained-session or pause close lease.

slot.description: A program slot (the wire spelling of InstallSlot).

text_read_budget.description: Which per-consumer text read budget of located OCR text ran out (Workflow #396 REC-1).

calls.description: The provider calls of one consumer.

area.description: The summed region area of one consumer, in pixels.

target_kind.description: Which kind of target a uniqueness check compared (Workflow #396 REC-2).

template.description: A template target: positions of its match score.

ocr.description: A locate OCR target: text blocks and their confidence.

value_side.description: Which side of a value test could not be read (Workflow #396 REC-6).

right.description: The right side, another read value.

value_problem.description: Why one side of a value test could not be read (Workflow #396 REC-6).

invalid.description: The text is not in the declared format.

overflow.description: The number does not fit 64 bits.

out_of_range.description: The value lies outside the declared min..=max.

region_unresolved.description: The OCR target's region could not be resolved on the frame.

low_confidence.description: The read's confidence is missing or below the OCR target's minimum_confidence.

value_op.description: The comparison of a value test (Workflow #396 REC-6).

parses.description: The left side reads in its format.

follow_problem.description: Why a Lab recording's click that follows a template mark does not hold (Workflow #396 REC-4).

not_template.description: The followed mark is not a template mark of the step.

not_required.description: The followed template is only a member of an any_of check, not a required mark of the step's page.

guard_conflict.description: The click guard names another mark than the followed template.

primary_mismatch.description: On the primary frame the template's best match is not at its crop, or not at factor 1000.

template_unmatched.description: On a frame the template does not pass in its search area.

click_outside_frame.description: On a frame the click box that follows the match leaves the frame.

device_category.description: The category of a device failure.

install_source.description: Which resolver rung found the MuMu installation.

count_kind.description: What a MuMu resolution count counts.

configured_adb_class.description: The class of the configured adb.

command.description: A program command or control request. Each Runtime slice adds the commands it reports.

held_check.description: Checking that the new owner is held.

owner_probe_state.description: What the operating system reported about a recorded owner process.

running.description: A process with the recorded id runs.

not_running.description: No process with the recorded id runs.

unknown.description: The operating system did not decide.

transport_kind.description: The kind of HTTP transport failure. Its tokens are registered with the first emitter.

disposition.description: Which side must act on a refusal.

device.description: The device or emulator must change.

uncertain.description: The result is unknown; check the state before trying again.

selection_state.description: The state of the installation selection.

root_tools_state.description: The state of the root Tools.

runtime_state.description: The state of the Runtime process.

not_terminated.description: Asked to stop, but not confirmed terminated.

file_state.description: The state of one file in an integrity check.

device_stage.description: The stage of a device failure. Its tokens are registered with the device codes.

device_backend.description: A capture or input backend. Its tokens are registered with the device codes.

mumu_root_source.description: How the MuMu folder was given or found.

env.description: The folder environment variable names it.

mcp_blocker.description: What must change before an MCP call can work.

server_tier.description: The server's tier must include the tool's tier.

install_root.description: The installation root must be known.

tools_dir.description: The root Tools folder must be known.

material_mode.description: The material mode must allow it.

state_root.description: The Runtime state root must be known (--state-root, or the configuration's state_root).

runtime_upgrade.description: actingd must be a release that serves the request.

input.description: An input field on a page or the command line.

invocation.description: Which entry of a program was invoked.

action.description: An action a run did or plans to do.

control.description: How a Runtime is closed or started.

cold.description: Cold: a shutdown request or a plain start.

language.description: A display language (a BCP 47 language tag).

dir.description: A program folder of an installation.

party_source.description: Where a party's interface ranges come from.

fate.description: What a real run does with an entry under the root.

root_tools_rule.description: Handled by the root Tools rule.

present.description: Which of two paired items is present.

record.description: The record a value is checked against.

section.description: A section of a vision manifest.

side.description: Which side of a decision stopped waiting.

unproved_by.description: Why a release order could not be proved.

installed_record_unreadable.description: The installed record cannot be read.

installed_record_orphaned.description: An installed record exists without an installation.

installed_time_missing.description: The installed release has no publication time.

candidate_time_missing.description: The candidate release has no publication time.

emulator_restart_phase.description: The phase of an emulator restart.

emulator_stop_result.description: How the Stop phase of an emulator restart ended: confirmed, or the token the host's stop-result table gives the stage the Stop failed at.

control.description: The Stop failed without a device diagnostic, at the default control stage (mumu_manager_control).

control_errcode.description: The shutdown command answered an errcode envelope with errcode not 0 (mumu_manager_control_errcode).

wait_timeout.description: The readiness wait for the stopped state expired (mumu_manager_wait_timeout).

run.description: MuMuManager could not be started, or a poll could not run (mumu_manager_run).

timeout.description: The shutdown command passed its bound (mumu_manager_timeout).

path.description: The MuMuManager path is not valid UTF-8 (mumu_manager_path).

errcode.description: An info poll answered an errcode envelope (mumu_manager_errcode).

entry.description: An info poll's instance entry carried an errcode envelope (mumu_manager_entry).

shape.description: An info poll answered an unexpected shape (mumu_manager_shape).

decode.description: An info poll's output is not UTF-8 (mumu_manager_decode).

json.description: An info poll's output is not JSON (mumu_manager_json).

output_bound.description: An info poll's output passed its bound (mumu_manager_output_bound).

unavailable.description: The instance has no MuMuManager binding (emulator_control_binding).

unsupported.description: The provider has no instance control (emulator_control_support).

unregistered.description: The instance is not registered with the provider (emulator_control_registration).

device_process_presence.description: Whether a vendor device process of an emulator instance was still running when a Stop's process listing last looked.

true.description: The last listing still showed the device process.

false.description: The last listing showed no device process of the instance.

unknown.description: No listing answered: it failed, passed its bound or never ran.

ledger_source.description: A revisioned source whose changes the ledger records (Workflow #383).

runtime_facts.description: The scheduler workbench's runtime fact store.

segment_edge.description: The edge of a reported stretch of a condition.

channel.description: The channel a Runtime connection is bound to: one of the general interface's three counters, or the Lab channel (Workflow #389).

cli.description: actingctl, and the installer and scripts that run it.

lab_option.description: One of the two Lab options of the installer page (Workflow #389).

pacing_stage.description: A performance pacing stage of an instance (Workflow #385): s0 is normal pacing, each later stage a worse responsiveness band.

s1.description: First signs: longer intervals and one more retry, never a pause.

s2.description: Tight: longer intervals and more retries, never a pause.

s3.description: Short: dispatch shares fall and the instances with the smallest share pause first.

s4.description: Severe: every dispatch pauses and running policy runs are held.

ladder_class.description: How the recovery ladder's trigger matching reads a code (Workflow #387). Every code entry names exactly one class: the first of these tokens, in this order, whose rule the code meets.

planned_stop.description: 1. Planned stop: a person, a rule or the pack's design stopped the run on purpose (a cancel, a pause, a performance yield or hold, a blackout window, a locked feature).

budget_or_permission.description: 2. Budget or permission: the work lacked time, samples, attempts, quota or permission (a sampling deadline, an insufficient sample budget, a run timeout, an exhausted policy budget).

declaration_error.description: 3. Declaration error: a pack, a binding or a configuration the work uses is itself wrong or incompatible; decided without looking at the screen, the same on every run.

pack_logic_mismatch.description: 4. Pack logic mismatch: the screen or the flow differs from what the pack declares; known only by looking at the screen (an unknown page, a failed or conflicting recognition, an unconfirmed step, an error page, an unmatched entry).

environment_fault.description: 5. Environment fault: a device, a backend, ADB, the emulator or the vision provider could not open or failed, and the work ended because of it.

stability_warning.description: 6. Stability warning: a device, connection, capture or input anomaly on one instance that the Runtime retried or survived; its category is warning or error. Repeated, it shows the environment getting worse.

none.description: 7. Not applicable: a success or an info, a Runtime-internal invariant, a refused request or contract value, a client error or a configuration error.

device_state_probe.description: A device-state read of a handset (model-398 section 7.1).

keyguard.description: dumpsys window policy: the keyguard section.

home.description: cmd package resolve-activity for the home intent.

settings.description: settings get of a screen-timeout setting.

device_config_problem.description: What is wrong with an instance's device declaration (model-398 section 10.1).

kind_unknown.description: device.kind is neither emulator nor handset.

transport_unsupported.description: device.transport is not usb on a handset (tcp is reserved), or is named on an emulator.

endpoint_with_handset.description: A handset names host, port or connect.

serial_in_config.description: A handset names serial: its serial lives only in the private binding file.

discovery_key_with_handset.description: A handset names instance_index, instance_name or nemu_app_index.

backend_kind_unsupported.description: The instance selects a backend its device kind does not allow.

alias_too_long.description: A handset's alias is longer than 248 bytes, so its label would not fit a name.

device_binding_problem.description: What is wrong with the private device-binding file (model-398 section 10.1).

unreadable.description: The file exists but cannot be read as a file.

malformed.description: The file is not JSON of the file's shape and schema, is larger than its bound, or names an alias no instance could have.

duplicate_alias.description: Two bindings name the same alias.

duplicate_serial.description: Two bindings name the same serial: one device is bound to one instance only.

serial_invalid.description: A serial is not 1 to 64 bytes of printable ASCII without white space.

device_link_state.description: The state of a handset's wired device link (model-398 section 4.2). The first six are what the adb server reports for the bound serial; the last two are the Runtime's own.

device.description: adb reports device: the handset answers.

absent.description: The bound serial is not in adb's device list (the cable is out).

unauthorized.description: adb reports unauthorized: a person allows USB debugging on the handset.

no_permissions.description: adb reports no permissions (a driver problem on the host).

other.description: adb reports another state (authorizing, connecting, recovery, sideload, bootloader and the like).

unwatched.description: The link watch is not running, so the Runtime cannot see the link.

unbound.description: The private binding file binds no device to the handset instance.

device_watch_problem.description: What went wrong with the device-link watch (model-398 section 4.3).

spawn_failed.description: The watch process could not be started.

exited.description: The watch process ended, or its output closed.

protocol_invalid.description: The watch's output has a shape the parser does not know.

restart_budget_spent.description: The watch ended more often within the restart window than the restart limit allows.

device_hold.description: What holds a handset (model-398 section 7.3 to 7.5), in the order its availability names the first of them (device_state:<hold>).

locked.description: A keyguard waits for a person (device_locked).

thermal.description: The thermal status reached the hold level (device_thermal_hold).

battery_low.description: On no power source, below the battery level (device_battery_low).

in_use.description: Another application was in the foreground at a run's start (device_in_use).

thermal_status.description: A handset's thermal status (model-398 section 7.1): Android's thermal status levels, mildest first. The device_state thermal keys take these words.

critical.description: Status 4: the platform has done everything it can to reduce power.

emergency.description: Status 5: key components are about to shut down.

shutdown.description: Status 6: the device shuts down at once.

standard_pack_problem.description: What is wrong with a standard-pack root file (Workflow #373 NAV-6).

malformed.description: The file is not JSON of the file's shape and version.

game_mismatch.description: The file's game is not the game directory it sits in.

bundle_invalid.description: bundle.json breaks the bundle index rules.

bundle_missing.description: The game root holds interrupts.json, navigation.json or pages.json but no bundle.json.

pages_missing.description: The game root holds interrupts.json or navigation.json but no pages.json.

page_id_invalid.description: A page id is not 1-64 bytes of [a-z][a-z0-9_]*.

page_duplicate.description: A page id is listed twice.

pages_count.description: pages holds no page, or more than 256.

features_count.description: features names no package, or more than 8.

package_not_listed.description: A named package is not a package of the game root's bundle.

server_duplicate.description: Two packages of one list belong to the same server.

interrupt_page_unlisted.description: An interrupt's page is not a page of pages.json.

interrupt_duplicate.description: Two interrupts name the same page.

packages_count.description: An interrupt's handlers or then.run names no package, or more than 8.

max_per_run_invalid.description: An interrupt's max_per_run is outside 1 to 8.

edges_count.description: navigation.json holds more than 1024 edges (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

edge_page_invalid.description: An edge's from or to is no page id: any, a draft's @origin or another word outside [a-z][a-z0-9_]* (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

edge_page_unlisted.description: An edge's from or to is not a page of pages.json (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

edge_self_loop.description: An edge's from and to are the same page (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

edge_duplicate.description: Two edges have the same from, to and package_id (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

recovery_chain_count.description: recovery_chain names no package, or more than 8 (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

recovery_chain_duplicate.description: recovery_chain names a package twice (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

registry_problem.description: Why a prerequisite package is not bound (Workflow #373 NAV-3a).

game_root_missing.description: The root holds no game root of the dependent package's game.

not_listed.description: The game root's bundle.json does not list the package.

navigation_role.description: The part a standard-pack package plays in a run (Workflow #373).

features.description: The feature package that recognises the pages of pages.json.

edge.description: The package of a navigation.json edge (NAV-5).

chain.description: A step of a navigation.json recovery chain (NAV-5).

handler.description: The handler package of a shared interrupt page.

then_run.description: The package a shared interrupt page's then.run names.

navigation_problem.description: Why a standard-pack package cannot play its part in a run (Workflow #373).

server_missing.description: The list names no package of the run's server.

admission_failed.description: The package could not be admitted; the loader's refusal is the cause.

role_ineligible.description: The package's declarations keep it from the part (execution mode, stability termination, post-admission OCR, resource readings or a designated operation).

identity_mismatch.description: Its game, server or resolution is not the run's package's.

prerequisite_declared.description: It declares a prerequisite package of its own.

entry_mismatch.description: Its entry does not hold the page it is named for.

page_set_mismatch.description: The feature package's pages are not exactly the pages of pages.json.

terminal_mismatch.description: An edge's package does not end on the edge's to page (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

application_entry.description: An edge's package is an application entry package (its entry is any), which no edge may be (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

navigation_limit.description: Which navigation bound a run reached (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

locates.description: The 16 full matches of one entry gate.

hops.description: The 16 edges one entry gate may run.

steps.description: The 1000 steps of a run, the next layer's max_steps included.

interrupts.description: The 16 shared interrupt handlings of a run.

config_value_problem.description: Why a configuration value is refused, the reason config_value_invalid carries (Workflow #387).

wrong_type.description: The value is not of the key's type.

out_of_range.description: The value is outside the key's allowed range or words.

section_check.description: The value leaves its section failing the section's whole-section check.

repeated_key.description: The request names the key more than once.

duplicate_id.description: Two trigger items of recovery_ladder.triggers share an id (Workflow #387 D1c).

stage_not_allowed.description: A trigger item names no stage, a stage twice, or a stage no item may name (recovery_preparation, resource_fence).

match_missing.description: A trigger item names neither classes nor codes.

code_unknown.description: A code, a code prefix or a ladder class the catalog does not list.

code_retired.description: A code the catalog lists as retired; its replaced_by names the successor.

burst_invalid.description: count and window_ms missing or zero on a stability_warnings item, or present on another.

start_rung_out_of_range.description: A start rung beyond the configured rungs.

rungs_invalid.description: No rung or more than three, an action twice or unknown, or a member of another action.

bound_out_of_range.description: A rung's bound below the device layer's own bound or outside its allowed range.

renewal_cap_exceeded.description: A rung's bound and the hold margin beyond the longest renewal a claim is granted.

claim_ttl_out_of_range.description: A ladder claim's TTL not above the heartbeat bound, beyond the longest renewal, or below the hold margin.

argument_problem.description: What is wrong with one command-line flag or MCP tool argument.

unknown.description: Not a flag of the command or an argument of the tool.

required.description: A required flag or argument is absent.

not_utf8.description: A command-line word that is not UTF-8.

wrong_type.description: Not of the type it must have.

out_of_range.description: A number or a length outside its range (range_min, range_max).

not_recognised.description: Text that is none of the spellings or forms it may take.

conflicting.description: Excludes, or needs, another flag or argument.

unusable.description: Names something that cannot be used: unreadable, not of its kind, or refused.

material_state.description: The state of a Runtime material read (RuntimeMaterialReadState).

verified.description: The material was read and verified.

not_provided.description: The Runtime did not provide the material.

missing.description: The material is missing from the store.

integrity_failed.description: The material failed its integrity check.

source_incomplete.description: The material's source record is incomplete.

material_limit.description: Why a Runtime material read stopped short (RuntimeMaterialReadLimit).

pending_eviction.description: The material is about to be evicted.

budget_exceeded.description: The read would exceed its byte budget.

reply_bytes.description: The reply would exceed its byte bound.

run_state.description: The state of a contained run as its ledger events show it (the runtime client's ContainedRunState).

not_found.description: The ledger has no event of the run.

admitted.description: The run was admitted and has not started.

interrupted_unterminated.description: A Runtime start or takeover came after the run's facts without a terminal; uncertain.

resource_targets_rejection_reason.description: Why the Runtime refused a resource-targets document (the contract's ResourceTargetsRejectionReason).

invalid_json.description: The document is not valid JSON.

duplicate_key.description: An object names a key twice.

unknown_field.description: A field the schema does not have.

invalid_type.description: A field of the wrong type.

invalid_value.description: A field value the schema does not allow.

unsupported_schema_version.description: A schema version the Runtime does not read.

duplicate_id.description: A target id, or a target resource in v2, named twice in the document.

unknown_instance.description: The document names an instance the Runtime's projection does not have.

validity_out_of_range.description: valid_until_unix_ms is not after now, or is more than a year ahead, or has passed.

catalog_unavailable.description: No active resource catalog to check against.

unknown_resource.description: A pool the active catalog does not list.

resource_not_observable.description: A pool that is not observed through a resource or inventory fact.

resource_out_of_scope.description: A pool whose scope does not cover the instance.

unknown_task.description: A task the catalog does not list.

task_out_of_scope.description: A task whose scope does not cover the instance.

task_disabled.description: A task an instance override of the instance disables.

unmapped_task.description: No run of the task produces the target's resource.

duplicate_task.description: A task named more than once in the document.

yield_cause.description: Why performance pacing ended a policy run to be rerun (Workflow #385).

wall_ceiling.description: The run reached its wall-clock ceiling after pacing lengthened it.

preempted.description: The run was preempted while it was held.

connectivity_reason.description: Why the operating system's internet connectivity status is unknown (Workflow #369 S6a): the reason host-metrics' network_connectivity gives.

level_unknown.description: The operating system reported its connectivity level as unknown, or a level this build does not know.

query_failed.description: The connectivity query returned an error code (os_error).

query_unsupported.description: The system library has no connectivity query (a Windows before 10 2004).

library_unavailable.description: The system library of the connectivity query could not be loaded (os_error).

unsupported_os.description: This operating system has no connectivity query.

pacing_cause.description: Why a pacing stage changed (Workflow #385 PERF section 11).

responsiveness.description: The tracked responsiveness moved the stage.

pressure.description: A pressure's stage-one floor began or ended.

idle_recovery.description: Without any evidence, the tracked value recovered toward the top.

pacing_mode.description: How far performance pacing takes effect (Workflow #385 PERF section 10.3): every release ships observe; pace and full are a person's configuration.

observe.description: Measure and record only; nothing takes effect.

pace.description: Lengthen intervals and deadlines, never pause.

full.description: Pacing and proportional pauses, with the learning period.

probe_kind.description: A host probe of the shadow measurement (Workflow #385 PERF section 3.2).

timer.description: Repeated short sleeps; their oversleep is the ready queue's delay.

message.description: A posted message's delay until its thread handles it.

signal_kind.description: A scored signal of the shadow measurement (Workflow #385 PERF section 3.2).

capture_acquire.description: One frame's acquisition from the capture backend.

remedy_source.description: The source that decided a remedy's allowed capabilities or a parameter's value, in the order the Runtime consults them (Workflow #411 B15).

target.description: The instance's target record session.remedy.choices (instance, server or game scope), written by a person or an agent.

configuration.description: The configuration rows in effect for the instance: scheduling.remedy.choices, or the instance's own list.

package.description: The package's declared default: the mapping's remedy default or the provider's parameter default.

remedy_problem.description: Why a remedy cannot be used, or why a blocked task stopped for a person (Workflow #411 B15).

no_choice.description: No target record, configuration row or package default names the need.

choice_none.description: The deciding source says no remedy for the need (a none row).

choice_invalid.description: A choice names a capability the remedy does not list or leaves nothing allowed, or a configuration row names a need or capability no bound package declares.

parameter_invalid.description: A chosen parameter is not declared by the provider, or its value is not one of the provider's options.

capability_unbound.description: No catalog task on the instance is bound to a package that provides the capability.

cycle.description: The remedy's providers lie on a cycle of blocked and provider tasks or packages, or are already in the chain.

parameters_mismatch.description: Providers of one capability declare different parameters.

provider_unavailable.description: Every provider is paused, its package suspended, or it is disabled for the instance by an override or a placement refusal.

round_limit.description: A layer used scheduling.remedy.max_per_round requests and the block remained.

depth_limit.description: A provider at the third layer of the chain ended blocked again.

capability_unprovided.description: No package of the game root provides the capability (package bundle and standard-pack check).

resource_verify_step.description: The steps of actinglab resource verify, in the order they run (Workflow #411 RV-1).

tools.description: The build that runs: its compiled head, its executable's SHA-256 and the build manifest beside it.

checkout.description: The precondition: the top of the work tree, HEAD, --commit, --base and the commit's clean tree.

declarations.description: The declaration selection built from Git, read by the reader of resource validate.

pins.description: The committed package_digest and sha256 members.

admission.description: The layout of packs/ and every pack admitted as package preflight admits it, with its identity.

format.description: package fmt --check of every pack directory.

bundle.description: The bundle, its index and copies, its zip, the read-back and the installed root.

git_command.description: The read-only git command that failed (Workflow #411 RV-1).

rev_parse.description: git rev-parse (the top level, HEAD, its tree, the base).

ls_files.description: git ls-files (the index with its blobs, or a pathspec selection).

diff.description: git diff --no-renames --name-status -z, or a status in its answer other than A, D, M or T.

checkout_problem.description: Why a checkout is not the commit to verify (Workflow #411 RV-1).

not_top_level.description: The path given is not the top of its Git work tree.

head_not_commit.description: HEAD names no commit or no tree.

commit_mismatch.description: The commit given is not HEAD.

dirty_problem.description: How a checkout differs from its commit's tree (Workflow #411 RV-1).

tracked_change.description: git status reports a changed, staged, deleted or unmerged tracked file.

untracked.description: An untracked file lies anywhere in the work tree.

ignored_in_read_path.description: An ignored file lies under packs/, regression/ or is a root input.

blob_mismatch.description: A file the command reads does not hash, without filters, to its committed blob, or is missing.

base_problem.description: Why a base revision is refused (Workflow #411 RV-1).

not_ancestor.description: The commit is not an ancestor of HEAD.

tools_problem.description: What the build manifest beside the executable does not confirm (Workflow #411 RV-1).

executable_sha256.description: Its actinglab.exe entry names other bytes than the executable's, or it has none; or the executable does not read.

commit.description: Its commit_sha is not the head the build was compiled from.

manifest_invalid.description: It does not read as a build manifest with commit_sha and files.

layout_problem.description: Which rule of a bundle source a repository breaks (Workflow #411 RV-1).

packs_missing.description: packs/ is missing or holds no pack directory.

packs_entry_invalid.description: packs/ holds an entry that is neither a pack directory nor packs/README.md.

pack_name_mismatch.description: The pack's control declares another package_id than its directory name.

pack_game_mismatch.description: The pack declares another game than applications.json.

pack_server_undeclared.description: The pack's server is not a server of applications.json.

bundle_problem.description: How a written bundle differs from its source (Workflow #411 RV-1).

index_schema.description: bundle.json is no bundle v4 index.

maintenance_differs.description: The index's maintenance is not maintenance.json's.

applications_differs.description: The bundled applications.json differs from the source's bytes, the index's game from its game, or the game is no directory name.

source_differs.description: The index's source is not the repository given at HEAD.

pack_list_differs.description: The indexed packs are not the pack directories of packs/, or an indexed pack's path, server or entry task differs from its source.

pack_copy_differs.description: A bundled pack does not hold its source's files, byte for byte.

pack_counts_differ.description: An indexed pack's file_count or byte_count is not its copy's.

default_package_unmatched.description: A server's default_package_id names not exactly one bundled pack of that server.

root_file_differs.description: The bundle root holds other entries than applications.json, bundle.json, packs and the root files given, or a root file differs from its source.

root_files_unread.description: standard-pack check of the installed root read other root files than bundle.json and the root files given, or another number of packs.

readback_problem.description: How a written zip reads back (Workflow #411 RV-1).

entry_set_differs.description: The zip reads back as another set of entries.

bytes_differ.description: An entry reads back as other bytes.

interfaces_differs.description: interfaces.json does not declare what was written.

fact_time_problem.description: Why a fact_time_reached predicate's fact gives no time (Workflow #405).

missing.description: No fact with this key exists in the predicate's scope.

stale.description: The fact was observed longer ago than the predicate's max_age_ms.

expired.description: The fact is past its own expiry.

not_a_time.description: The fact's value is not a timestamp_ms value.

decision_state.description: The state of a scheduling decision, as a dispatch decision record gives it for each candidate it lists (Workflow #411 A26).

eligible.description: Nothing deferred or blocked the candidate this round.

deferred.description: Something holds the candidate back for now; a later round may run it.

blocked.description: The candidate cannot run until its inputs change.

selected.description: The candidate was dispatched this round.

eligibility.description: The eligibility of a scheduling decision, what its trigger and feedback stop decided, as a dispatch decision record gives it for each candidate it lists (Workflow #411 A26).

true.description: The trigger passed and the feedback stop did not fire.

false.description: Not eligible: the trigger is false, the feedback stop fired, or the scope matches no instance.

unknown.description: Not decided: a predicate is unknown, or the candidate was settled before its trigger was read.

program_problem.description: Which rule of a contained task's program refused it at admission (Workflow #411 A39).

operations_empty.description: The task declares no operation, which only a task schema 0.8 zero-input reading task without recovery may (contracts/ocr-fields.md).
